status: PROPOSED v2, 28 Oct 2026 (supersedes v1 of 27 Oct). NOT CREATED in the live base. Created only in a separate, approved activation step. The existing airtable-schema.json still describes the live base and is unchanged.
base: the existing PlotArt base ('PlotNua Art Space Register'), using the existing Worker token, which is already scoped to that base

new_table.name: Founding 25 applications
new_table.note: PRIVATE. Applications to be CONSIDERED for the Founding 25 (A). Accepting a place (B) and authorising publication (C) are recorded separately, by the founder. Never exported to any public page. Separate from the Artist Register ('Artists').

fields.name: application_ref
fields.note: F25-YYMMDD-XXXXXX; the reference quoted in every email

fields.name: artist_name
fields.note: at most 80 characters

fields.name: email_key
fields.note: lower-case email; duplicate check within this table only

fields.name: region
fields.note: required; one of the 32 counties (based or working in Ireland)

fields.name: medium
fields.note: required; primary medium

fields.name: bio
fields.note: required; 40-1,000 characters; private, never published from here

fields.name: portfolio
fields.note: optional since 29 Oct 2026: a portfolio link OR at least three uploaded images; https (a bare address is given https://)

fields.name: website
fields.note: optional; https only

fields.name: social_link
fields.note: optional; an @handle or an https link

fields.name: additional_info
fields.note: optional; at most 800 characters

fields.name: artwork_images
fields.note: added 29 Oct 2026; how many artwork images were uploaded (0-5); the images are private in R2 plotart-applications (EU)

fields.name: artwork_review
fields.note: added 29 Oct 2026; the founder-only PlotArt Studio page showing the uploaded images (behind Cloudflare Access); never a storage URL

fields.name: eligibility_confirmed
fields.note: the applicant ticked: 18 or over, based or working in Ireland

fields.name: ownership_confirmed
fields.note: the applicant ticked: own original work, or authorised to represent the artist

fields.name: privacy_notice_read
fields.note: the applicant ticked: has read the application privacy notice (transparency, not consent)

fields.name: status
fields.note: the Worker writes 'received' only; every other value is set by the founder

fields.name: submitted_at
fields.note: UTC

fields.name: submission_id
fields.note: random id generated by the page per application; retries reuse it (duplicate safeguard)

fields.name: privacy_version
fields.note: the published privacy notice version in force

fields.name: consent_version
fields.note: version of the three confirmation sentences, e.g. F25-APPLICATION-2026-10-28

fields.name: consent_at
fields.note: UTC; equals submitted_at

fields.name: consent_text_hash
fields.note: SHA-256 of the three sentences as confirmed

fields.name: review_notes
fields.note: factual, relevant notes only; the applicant can ask to see them

fields.name: waiting_list
fields.note: kept for a future place with the applicant's agreement (E-3)

fields.name: acknowledged_at
fields.note: confirmation email (E-1) sent

fields.name: terms_version
fields.note: B · the Founding Artist terms version offered

fields.name: terms_sent_at
fields.note: B

fields.name: terms_accepted_at
fields.note: B · the artist's written acceptance; only now does the place count

fields.name: publication_approved_at
fields.note: C · the artist approved their gallery preview; separate from B

fields.name: first_published_at
fields.note: C · the founding year begins on this date

fields.name: counts_toward_25
fields.note: the ONLY source of the Founding 25 count

fields.name: erase_after
fields.formula: IF(OR({status}='not_selected', {status}='withdrawn'), DATEADD(IF({status_changed_at}, {status_changed_at}, {submitted_at}), 12, 'months'), IF(OR({status}='received', {status}='under_review', {status}='shortlisted'), DATEADD({submitted_at}, 12, 'months'), IF({agreement_ended_at}, DATEADD({agreement_ended_at}, 12, 'months'))))
fields.note: FLAG ONLY; deletes nothing. Matches the retention periods in the privacy notice draft

statuses.not_selected: founder (the waiting_list box may be ticked)

manual_steps: Formula fields, views and the three new select choices are created by hand in Airtable (the connector cannot create formulas or views, or add choices).
deletion: delete its Status log rows (record_ref = the row id) and its Consent proofs row (matched by given_at = consent_at and register founding_25)
add one anonymous Deletion log row (register founding_25)
